title: Cloudflare Drop
summary: Cloudflare Drop is a feature that allows users to set automatic expiration dates on Cloudflare Pages projects, enabling temporary website hosting for hackathons, events, or short-lived applications without manual cleanup.
problem_solved: Solves the problem of manual cleanup and forgotten temporary websites by automatically deleting projects after a specified expiration date.
why_valuable: It reduces storage costs and improves project management efficiency for developers hosting temporary projects on Cloudflare's platform.
